attendance.note: Organiser-reported (2023 media fact sheet): the 2022/23 festival drew 'an aggregate audience of over 120,000 visitors', which 'translates into 35,000 unique visitors' (Qld 20,013, interstate 14,254, international 1,728).

audience.psychographics: All ages per organiser: families, young partygoers, music lovers, community leaders, educators, students, artists, environmentalists and retired professionals; 70% repeat visitors; 2022/23 visitors 8% local, 60.4% elsewhere in Qld, 30% interstate, 1.2% overseas.

add_sources.note: Official site: 'Woodford Folk Festival 27 Dec 26 to 1 Jan 27', Jinibara Country, Woodford.

Media page: 'produced by Woodfordia Ltd. a not-for profit community arts organisation and is supported by the Queensland Government through Arts Queensland and Tourism and Events Queensland' (Google snippet and crawl).
Footer: Copyright Woodfordia, ABN 74 616 312 239, ACNC registered charity logo.
FAQ: Season ticket 'valid for all 6 days of the festival, 27 Dec to 1 Jan'; 2026/27 programme published.
ABC (30 Dec 2025): Woodford Folk Festival's 38th year, more than 450 acts across six days.
2023 media fact sheet: 2022/23 aggregate audience over 120,000, 35,000 unique visitors; 2023/24 estimated aggregate up to 120,000; site infrastructure for up to 20,000 patrons per day.
Fact sheet: programme 'reflects the broad and diverse demographic'; '70% of the audience are repeat visitors'; visitor origins from the 2022/23 Visitor Survey.
Sponsors page (crawled Oct 2026, 'this year's festival'): supported by the Queensland Government through TEQ; sponsor logos Coopers Brewing, Arris Water, Cave Urban, McCullough Robertson Lawyers.
Fact sheet (2023/24): cycling initiative 'In partnership with Epic Cycles' (priority gate entry and luggage transport for cyclists).
Contact page lists reception, ticketing, volunteers, glamping, stalls and media@woodfordia.com; no sponsorship-specific address.
